kultivator.spine9.config.immortalRealm: immortalRealm: the ascension to Alam Abadi (the kultivator:alam_abadi dimension of floating islands) is possible at all.
kultivator.spine9.config.immortalRealmRa: immortalRealmRadius (512-4096): radius of the soft circular border around 0,0 in Alam Abadi; beyond it players are pushed back (no world border change).
kultivator.spine9.config.immortalNatives: immortalNativesPerPlayer (0-6): Alam Abadi natives within 48 blocks of one player.
kultivator.spine9.config.immortalNativeW: immortalNativeWorldCap (4-16): Alam Abadi natives alive in the whole dimension.
kultivator.spine9.config.primordialBeast: primordialBeasts: the primordial beasts Kun-Peng, Zhulong and Taotie appear at all.
kultivator.spine9.config.primordialChanc: primordialChanceScale (0-3): multiplies the chance of a natural Gejolak Purba.
kultivator.spine9.config.primordialDeath: primordialDeathGuard: a lethal hit from a primordial skill leaves the player at 1 HP with Luka Purba instead of killing.
kultivator.spine9.config.starCalamities: starCalamities: the player's Seven Star Calamities gate the stars (off: stars are never gated).
kultivator.spine9.config.heavenlyWrath: heavenlyWrath: the Heavens send envoy waves and the Panglima Langit to players who passed a calamity.
kultivator.spine9.config.heavenlyWrathDa: heavenlyWrathDays (3-15): in-game days between two wrath rolls (plus or minus 1).
kultivator.spine9.config.innerWorld: innerWorld: the inner world (Dunia Batin) is born at the ascension.
kultivator.spine9.config.innerWorldCalam: innerWorldCalamityDays (3-15, 0 = off): in-game days between two earthly calamities of the inner world.
kultivator.spine9.config.immortalAuction: immortalAuction: the Immortal auction holds a session in Alam Abadi every 2 in-game days.
kultivator.spine9.config.auctionPursuitC: auctionPursuitChance (0-1): chance that an offended rival bidder sends a pursuit after the session.

kultivator.spine9.refuse.hall: The Immortal Realm accepts no Sect Hall: its islands belong to no sect.
